title: Roasted Pumpkin & Chickpea Salmon Bowl
description: Smoky roasted chickpeas, caramelised pumpkin, lemon-soy salmon and a silky tahini-Dijon dressing over rice.

steps.text: Preheat the oven to 220°C. Toss the pumpkin ({{pumpkin}}) with 2 tbsp olive oil, half the garlic, the cumin ({{cumin}}), smoked paprika ({{smoked-paprika}}) and chilli flakes ({{chilli}}). Spread on a lined tray in a single layer.
Roast 15 minutes, until starting to colour. Meanwhile cook the rice ({{rice}}).

Pat the chickpeas ({{chickpeas}}) dry and toss in a little oil, cumin and paprika. Add to the tray and roast a further 12–15 minutes, until crisp. Add the sesame seeds ({{sesame}}) for the last few minutes.
Pan-sear the salmon in the butter ({{butter}}), then glaze with the soy sauce ({{soy}}), a squeeze of lemon and the remaining garlic.
Whisk the tahini ({{tahini}}), Dijon ({{dijon}}), a squeeze of lemon and the warm water ({{water}}) to a pourable dressing.

Build the bowls: rice, roasted pumpkin and chickpeas, salmon, then the cabbage salad ({{cabbage-salad}}). Drizzle with the dressing and finish with shaved parmesan ({{parmesan}}) and parsley ({{parsley}}).

notes.title: Tip
notes.text: The tahini dressing is the magic element. Make extra; it keeps in the fridge for a week.
